names.form: Sfântul Cuvios Iosif de la Bisericani

names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 24 Απριλίου, «Όσιος Ιωσήφ ο Ομολογητής εκ Ρουμανίας», with the rank word, the epithet and the country left off.

source.text: doxologia.ro, 1 octombrie — „Sfântul Cuvios Iosif de la Bisericani”
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 24ης Απριλίου — «Όσιος Ιωσήφ ο Ομολογητής εκ Ρουμανίας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 24 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **The Greek keeps him here and the Romanian keeps him on 1 octombrie**; the folder's Romanian row stands where it is and this row records the day page that was read. That the two are one man is not in doubt: saint.gr calls him the first hesychast of the mountain of Bisericani in Moldavia and the founder of the monastery there, born in a village of the Neamț country, tonsured at Bistrița, gone with the blessing of the abbot Dometian to the Holy Places and then into the wilderness of the Jordan, gathered a brotherhood of fifteen Romanians and two Greeks who kept the week alone and met on Sundays at the monastery of Gerasimos of the Jordan, driven back to Moldavia by Arab raids, and settled at last on the mountain of Bisericani with the disciples Simon, Methodius, Barnabas, Averkios, Germanos and Pyrrhos, whose names the local hill-names still carry — which is the Romanian life of Joseph of Bisericani almost sentence for sentence. **Two things on the page do not hold together, and no `dates` were taken because of them.** Its heading and its last sentence give «(; - 1711)» and «κοιμήθηκε με ειρήνη το έτος 1711 μ.Χ.», while its second sentence puts his birth in the fifteenth century — «Γεννήθηκε κατά τον 15ο αιώνα μ.Χ.» — and it says he lived on his mountain more than thirty years; the page reconciles none of this. Its rank word for him, «ο Ομολογητής», the Confessor, is one neither its own narrative nor doxologia's supports, and no rank was added to this folder's `types` on the strength of it. It prints no hymn.

hymns.text: Povățuitori sihaștrilor, ocrotitori ai celor din nevoi și celor mâhniți mângâietori, Sfinților Cuvioși Iosif și Chiriac cei ce ați dobândit rugăciunea cea de foc și vase alese a Sfântului Duh v-ați făcut, rugați-vă lui Dumnezeu să dăruiască sufletelor noastre pace și mare milă!

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfinților Cuvioși Iosif și Chiriac de la Bisericani

english.text: Guides of hermits, protectors of those in need and comforters of the sorrowful, holy and venerable Joseph and Cyriacus, who acquired the prayer of fire and became chosen vessels of the Holy Spirit: pray to God to grant our souls peace and great mercy.

hymns.text: Rugăciunea și liniștea iubind, nevoința și răbdarea îmbrățișând, patimile cele pierzătoare le-ați stins cu ostenelile pustiei, Sfinților Cuvioși Iosif și Chiriac de la Bisericani. Unul, luminător al chinoviei s-a făcut și iscusit păstor, iar celălalt sfeșnic al luminii neînserate s-a arătat, prin rugăciunea cea înaltă.

source.text: Doxologia — Condacul Sfinților Cuvioși Iosif și Chiriac de la Bisericani

english.text: Loving prayer and stillness, embracing struggle and patience, you quenched the destroying passions with the labours of the wilderness, holy and venerable Joseph and Cyriacus of Bisericani. The one became a light of the common life and a skilful shepherd; the other showed himself a lampstand of the unwaning light through lofty prayer.
